prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Indicate personal injury or occupational illness. See Form 1 on the next page for an example.
3. Determine if your employer meets the employment eligibility formula. See page 2.
4. Determine if the employability precludes the worker to perform the duties for which they were hired at the time of the injury. See page 3.
5. Identify if there are lost days to employment or days off work. See page 4.
6. Identify if medical attention freed from that routinely provided for self-care. See page 5.
7. Make the final determination as to whether or not the injury is reportable. See page 6.
8. Input the injury information on the Form 300A (see sample form).
